panels.title: EC (mS/cm): medida, consigna y pronóstico LSTM

targets.query: from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensores" and (r._field == "ec")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "control" and (r._field == "ec_consigna" or r._field == "ec_pronostico")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: pH: medido, consigna y pronóstico LSTM

targets.query: from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensores" and (r._field == "ph")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "control" and (r._field == "ph_consigna" or r._field == "ph_pronostico")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Temperatura del aire (°C) y del agua

targets.query: from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensores" and (r._field == "temp_air" or r._field == "t_water")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensores" and (r._field == "rh")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acciones" and (r._field == "ab_ml" or r._field == "acido_ml" or r._field == "base_ml")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "latencia" and (r._field == "deteccion_accion_ms" or r._field == "inferencia_ms")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alertas" and (r._field == "ec_dev" or r._field == "ph_dev")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "hidroponia") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensores" and (r._field == "lux" or r._field == "nitrogen")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
